title.narrative: Providing Essential Integrated WASH, Protection and Education Services to the Most Vulnerable Children in the West Bank and the Gaza Strip.

description.narrative: This project primarily aims to contribute to addressing the urgent humanitarian needs of over one million children affected by the renewed violence and deteriorating socio-economic conditions in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank. This CERF RR project will allow UNICEF to provide integrated WASH, Protection - CP, and EiE services. Through these activities, the project expects to mitigate the immediate risks and long-term psychological effects faced by an estimated 36,168 people including 22,570 children and their families, by ensuring their access to essential services, and promote a stable environment conducive to learning and growth.
